name: fused_softmax_pool
description: fused_softmax_pool(kv_score, head_dim) -> out. kv_score has shape [bs, k, 2*head_dim]. The first head_dim channels along the last axis are values v and the last head_dim channels are scores s. For each batch b and column d in [0, head_dim), compute out[b, d] = sum_j v[b, j, d] * exp(s[b, j, d] - max_j s[b, j, d]) / sum_j exp(s[b, j, d] - max_j s[b, j, d]) in fp32, then cast to kv_score.dtype. Returns a newly allocated [bs, head_dim] tensor. No input mutation. When k == 0 and bs > 0, the output is filled with zeros. The exercised dtype is bfloat16 with k in {3, 4, 16, 64} and head_dim 64, 96, or 128.
